let Column := Nat → Bool
let disj (ws : List Column) (r : Nat) := ws.any (fun w => w r)
let both (a b : Column) (r : Nat) := a r && b r
let wire (s : List Column) (i : Nat) := s.getD i (fun _ => false)
let addOr (s : List Column) (g : Nat × Nat) := s ++ [fun r => wire s g.1 r || wire s g.2 r]
let Gate := Bool × Nat × Nat
let step (s : List Column) (g : Gate) : List Column :=
  if g.1 then s ++ [both (wire s g.2.1) (wire s g.2.2)] else addOr s g.2

let extend (x : Nat) : Nat :=
  let b (i : Nat) := (x >>> i) &&& 1
  x ||| ((b 0 ||| b 1) <<< 26) ||| ((b 3 ||| b 9) <<< 27)
let pos (i : Nat) := extend (positive[i]!)
let neg (i : Nat) := extend (negative[i]!)
let input (j : Nat) : Column := fun r =>
  (if r < 52 then pos r else neg (r-52)).testBit j
let mix (op : Bool) (a b : Column) : Column := fun r =>
  if op then a r && b r else a r || b r
let base (i : Fin 30) : Column :=
  if i.val < 28 then input i.val
  else if i.val = 28 then mix true (input 15) (input 27)
  else mix true (input 17) (input 26)

∀ i j : Fin 468, i < j →
    let good (q : Nat) := ∀ k : Fin 30, base k (q+4) = true →
      base k (52+i.val) = true ∨ base k (52+j.val) = true
    (∃ ps : List Nat, ps.Nodup ∧ 5 ≤ ps.length ∧ ∀ q ∈ ps, q < 48 ∧ good q) ∨
      ∃ m ∈ labels[j.val]!, ∀ q : Fin 48, m.testBit q.val = true → good q.val
